why: The onset reference failed its own validation (dbs-reference handback 2026-10-14T23:0xZ): planted-attack recall at >= -18 dB 0.53 (BOOM set A), 0.40 (set B), 0.79 (Sonic) against a 0.90 requirement; it fires 16.75 detections/s on the attack-free sustain probe; Sonic timing p95 8.6 ms raw / 13.6 ms refined against 6 ms. Using every v1 reference onset would turn noise-flux detections into 'arrivals', absorb real false births and inflate the missed set. BOOM timing passes (p95 3.5 / 2.9 ms).
state_at_freeze: Arm, plant and probe replays (arms/*) were generated before this amendment; NO arm, plant or probe result has been scored or inspected. All replays are rerun after this freeze and must be byte-identical to the pre-freeze files; the scored files are the post-freeze ones.
unchanged: Everything in v1 not named here: arms, tap, calibration procedure, strength 0.25, birth rule (A_k >= 0.05, local max, prominence >= 1.20 over min of 3 frames each side), matching window [t_o - 5 ms, t_o + 45 ms], one-to-one greedy, M1/M2/M3 thresholds, winner rule, plants, off-path and isolation requirements.

boom_reference.time_field: time_s (refined; BOOM plant timing p95 3.5 / 2.9 ms)
boom_reference.salient_set_R: scored onsets (28-75 s) with picked_up_to_delta > 29.158 (strongest steady-span detection on the attack-free sustain probe at the frozen delta 3; scripts/p6_dbs_salience_floor.py): 207 onsets
boom_reference.ambiguous_set_A: scored onsets with picked_up_to_delta <= 29.158: a birth matched to one of these (one-to-one, after R is matched) is neither credited nor counted false
boom_reference.false_birth: a birth in the scored window matched to neither R nor A
boom_reference.missed_set: R onsets in dense context, unmatched by the baseline, cue present in the raw bank (v1 rule); predeclared from arm0 only and hashed before any arm is scored

sonic_transfer.reason: At 12.8 kHz the same probe floor is 37.323 and only 3 of 319 scored Sonic onsets exceed it, so the Sonic reference cannot support a false-birth count.
sonic_transfer.S1_retention: >= 95% of baseline births have an arm birth within +-1 render frame (10 ms) on sonic_room 0.5-23.5 s
sonic_transfer.S2_no_unanchored_growth: births matched to no Sonic reference onset at all (any strength) are no more than the baseline's
sonic_transfer.limit: weak evidence of transfer; disclosed as such

probes.truth: exact planted event times from the probe JSON (scripts/p6_dbs_probes.py), matched with the same [-5, +45] ms window
probes.P1_sustain: births on sustain.s16 over its 10 s layer span no more than the baseline's
probes.P2_weak: planted weak attacks matched on weak_alone, weak_over_sustain and the 12 weak attacks of quiet_recovery no fewer than the baseline's
probes.P3_spacing: spacing_200/100/75 distinct matched births per train reported, not gating

known_limit: The reference under-detects kicks (recall 0.13-0.33). A kick that an arm makes visible but the reference missed is scored as a false birth, which biases against the arms, not for them.
